title: Nyari Dam, Rajkot - A Tranquil Getaway Amid Nature
content:
Nyari Dam, Rajkot

Nestled on the outskirts of Rajkot, Nyari Dam is one of the most popular and peaceful spots for nature lovers and photography enthusiasts. Built across the Nyari River, the dam not only serves as a vital water reservoir for Rajkot but also as a serene getaway where people can unwind amidst nature.

The dam is surrounded by lush greenery and open landscapes, making it a perfect spot for picnics, morning walks, and evening relaxation. The tranquil water, combined with the soothing sounds of chirping birds, offers an escape from the city's fast-paced life. During the monsoon season, the dam turns into a breathtaking site as the water level rises and the surrounding hills come alive with vibrant colors.

Nyari Dam is also a paradise for photographers and sunset lovers. The sight of the setting sun reflecting on the calm waters creates a mesmerizing view that leaves visitors spellbound. It’s a favorite hangout spot for families, couples, and even solo travelers who seek a quiet connection with nature.

Besides its scenic charm, the dam plays an important role in supplying drinking water to Rajkot city. Its clean surroundings and maintained walkways make it suitable for jogging or cycling, especially during early mornings and late evenings.

There are small snack stalls near the area, offering tea, coffee, and local snacks, making it easy to spend a few relaxing hours here. Whether you’re looking for a short weekend escape or just a peaceful evening spot, Nyari Dam is an ideal destination to rejuvenate your mind and soul.

Best Time to Visit

The best time to visit Nyari Dam is from October to February, when the weather is pleasant and the water level is high. The monsoon months (July-September) are also ideal for witnessing the dam in its full glory.

How to Reach

Nyari Dam is located about 8 km from Rajkot city center.

  • By Road: Easily accessible by auto-rickshaw, cab, or private vehicle.
  • By Train: Rajkot Railway Station is the nearest railhead, about 10 km away.
  • By Air: Rajkot Airport is approximately 12 km from the dam.

Entry Fee and Timings: 

  • Timings: Approximately 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. 
  • Entry Fee: Free for all visitors.
